title: OpenAI and AMD announce a deal to deploy 6 GW of AMD GPUs, with warrants for OpenAI to take up to 10% of AMD
summary: AMD and OpenAI said the multi-year agreement covers several Instinct GPU generations and gives OpenAI warrants for up to 160 million AMD shares.

title: China's commerce ministry widens rare-earth export controls, with case-by-case review for some advanced-chip and AI uses
summary: MOFCOM announcements of 9 October extend licensing to more rare-earth items and technologies, which the ministry ties to chip manufacturing and military-linked AI research.

title: OpenAI and Sur Energy announce plan for a 'Stargate Argentina' AI data centre in Patagonia, reported at USD 25bn
summary: OpenAI and the Argentine energy firm Sur Energy signed a letter of intent for a large AI data-centre project in Patagonia; the USD 25bn figure comes from press reports.

title: OpenAI and Broadcom announce 10 GW of OpenAI-designed AI accelerators, deployment from late 2026
summary: OpenAI will design its own accelerators and Broadcom will develop and deploy them together with Ethernet networking, in a multi-year partnership.

title: Google announces a USD 15bn AI data-centre hub in Visakhapatnam, India, over five years
summary: Google said it will invest about USD 15bn in a gigawatt-scale AI hub in Andhra Pradesh; Hindi outlets put the figure at about Rs 88,000 crore.

title: DeepSeek releases open-source OCR model; developers say one GPU can process 200,000 pages a day
summary: DeepSeek published DeepSeek-OCR, which compresses long text into image tokens, with open weights.

title: Future of Life Institute statement calls for a ban on superintelligence until safe and publicly backed; 700+ signatories at launch
summary: The statement, signed by AI researchers, business figures and public figures, asks for a prohibition on developing superintelligence until there is broad scientific consensus on safety and strong public buy-in.

title: Anthropic says it will use up to one million Google TPUs in a deal reported at tens of billions of dollars
summary: Anthropic and Google Cloud announced an expansion of their compute agreement that adds well over a gigawatt of capacity in 2026.

title: School AI gun-detection system flags a Doritos bag as a weapon in Baltimore County; student handcuffed (reported)
summary: Local news reported that an AI security system at a Baltimore County high school flagged a student's snack bag as a gun and police detained the student before the alert was cleared.

title: OpenAI to offer ChatGPT Go free for 12 months to users in India from 4 November
summary: OpenAI said the paid Go tier will be free for a year for users who sign up in India during a limited window, announced at a developer event in Bengaluru.

title: Character.AI says it will end open-ended chat for users under 18 and add age assurance
summary: The company announced the restriction for minors amid lawsuits and regulatory pressure over teen use of companion chatbots.

title: Nvidia becomes the first company valued at USD 5 trillion; Huang cites USD 500bn of Blackwell and Rubin orders
summary: Nvidia's market value passed USD 5tn a day after its Washington event, where Huang said bookings for Blackwell and Rubin chips reach USD 500bn through 2026.

title: Samsung and SK sign letters of intent with OpenAI on Stargate, including memory supply of up to 900,000 wafers a month
summary: After meeting Sam Altman in Seoul, Samsung and SK agreed to supply DRAM for Stargate and explore data centres in South Korea.

title: Japan's government says it asked OpenAI not to infringe copyright with Sora 2 after anime-style videos spread
summary: Minister Minoru Jonai said the Cabinet Office's IP secretariat formally requested that OpenAI avoid copyright-infringing outputs of Japanese anime and game characters.

title: Dutch government invokes Goods Availability Act to intervene in Wingtech-owned chipmaker Nexperia; Wingtech calls it geopolitically driven
summary: The Netherlands cited governance deficiencies threatening crucial technology and may block Nexperia management decisions; Wingtech said it will seek legal remedies.

title: India's IT ministry proposes amendments to IT Rules requiring visible labels on AI-generated and synthetic content
summary: MeitY's draft amendment would oblige platforms and AI tools to label synthetic content and obtain user declarations, aimed at curbing deepfakes.

title: Saudi Arabia's HUMAIN and Blackstone-backed AirTrunk agree a data-centre partnership with an initial project of about USD 3bn
summary: HUMAIN, AirTrunk and Blackstone signed a long-term deal to finance, build and operate AI data-centre capacity in Saudi Arabia.

title: After Xi-Trump talks in Busan, China agrees to suspend its 9 October export controls, incl. rare earths, for one year
summary: Following the leaders' meeting, China said it would pause the expanded controls on rare earths and related items for a year while studying implementation details.

title: Nvidia says it will supply more than 260,000 GPUs to South Korea's government, Samsung, SK, Hyundai and Naver
summary: Announced at APEC in Gyeongju, the deal covers GPUs for sovereign AI infrastructure and AI factories at Korean firms.
